narrative.details: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Dark Leather Shoulders, along with information about delivery location and payment.  At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
narrative.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
narrative.offerRewardText: Thar be me shoulderpads, at last! Ever had one of these squakers perch on your shoulder? Bet ye' haven't! Their claws, they hurt! Now they got a place to rest all day, and you have a heavier coinpurse! <Narkk eyes said coinpurse.> For now!
narrative.requestItemsText: Yarr, what business do ye' have with ol' Narkk?
